title: A task from start to finish
desc: You say what you want. The AI writes a plan, which fresh AIs check, and cuts it into small tickets. For each ticket: the tests are written and locked first, and the AI builds until it scores 70%, each time from its best try. After 3 tries, it asks the advisor: a second AI, or you. The gate passes the change, and it is merged; you merge the risky ones. You read the report, and up to 3 lessons become rules for the next task.

nodes.text:
You say what you want
In plain words

The AI writes a plan
Fresh AIs check it

It cuts the plan into tickets
Each one small

Tests are written, then locked
Before any code

The AI builds
Until it scores 70%,
from its best try

The gate passes it
Then it is merged.
You merge the risky ones.

You read the report
Done, and still to do

Ask the advisor
A second AI, or you

Mistakes become rules
Up to 3 lessons,
for the next task
